title: Teaching cooking
simplified_paragraphs: 我会做很多东西，我最喜欢做菜。我的朋友、爸爸妈妈都喜欢我做的菜。他们也都很高兴能吃我做的东西，因为很好吃。有一天，我的好朋友说想学做菜，想请我教他，我同意了。我告诉他怎么做，但是他总是做不好。我觉得当老师太难了。
traditional_paragraphs: 我會做很多東西，我最喜歡做菜。我的朋友、爸爸媽媽都喜歡我做的菜。他們也都很高興能吃我做的東西，因為很好吃。有一天，我的好朋友說想學做菜，想請我教他，我同意了。我告訴他怎麼做，但是他總是做不好。我覺得當老師太難了。
pinyin_paragraphs: wǒ huì zuò hěn duō dōng xi， wǒ zuì xǐ huan zuò cài。 wǒ de péng you、 bà ba mā ma dōu xǐ huan wǒ zuò de cài。 tā men yě dōu hěn gāo xìng néng chī wǒ zuò de dōng xi， yīn wèi hěn hǎo chī。 yǒu yī tiān， wǒ de hǎo péng you shuō xiǎng xué zuò cài， xiǎng qǐng wǒ jiāo tā， wǒ tóng yì le。 wǒ gào su tā zěn me zuò， dàn shì tā zǒng shì zuò bù hǎo。 wǒ jué de dāng lǎo shī tài nán le。
english_paragraphs: I can make lots of things, but I like cooking best. My friends and parents all like the dishes I make. They’re always happy to eat my cooking because it tastes so good. One day, my best friend said he wanted to learn to cook and asked me to teach him. I agreed. I told him how to make the dishes, but he never seemed to get them right. I think being a teacher is too hard.
english_full: I can make lots of things, but I like cooking best. My friends and parents all like the dishes I make. They’re always happy to eat my cooking because it tastes so good. One day, my best friend said he wanted to learn to cook and asked me to teach him. I agreed. I told him how to make the dishes, but he never seemed to get them right. I think being a teacher is too hard.
